summary: Learn the importance of ergonomics in the workplace. Join our Human Factors Training Course to improve safety, comfort, and efficiency for all employees.
lede: Workplace ergonomics training helps safety officers, wellness managers, and supervisors assess how workspaces and tasks affect comfort and physical strain. It covers configuring office, field, and remote workstations, identifying musculoskeletal risk factors, evaluating posture and lifting techniques, and using ergonomic checklists to guide practical changes to equipment and workflows.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals across various fields who are responsible for workplace safety, comfort, and productivity. Whether you're managing a team on-site or remotely, the principles you'll learn are applicable and beneficial.
modules: Foundations of Ergonomics and Human Factors
Anatomy, Body Mechanics, and Posture Awareness
Workstation Setup for Office, Field, and Remote Work
Identifying Risk Factors for Musculoskeletal Disorders (MSDs)
Ergonomics in Industrial and Physical Work Environments
Cognitive Ergonomics and Reducing Mental Load
Tools, Equipment, and Workspace Design Principles
Movement, Lifting, and Safe Work Techniques
Ergonomic Risk Assessment Tools and Checklists
Building a Sustainable Ergonomics and Wellness Culture
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of workplace safety principles. Prior experience in human resources, health and safety, or facilities management is beneficial but not required.
